verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street's products page mentions "status dashboards", but only in the context of running multiple cases in parallel, which reads as the employer/team offering. It also promises "a simple checklist from start to approval", which loosely covers next steps. Neither claim describes a client portal a founder can log into, and both are single marketing lines. Missing for 10: a documented client portal or login, a description of the case-status views and next-step tracking available to an individual founder, screenshots or help docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see where my case is — a client portal or dashboard with case status and next steps is a documented part of the product

citations.quote: Run multiple cases in parallel with clean workflows, SLAs, and status dashboards.
a simple checklist from start to approval
